items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: With Claude Hopeton... Billy Taylor was on bass. Sammy Hodges on drums... Paul Bernett was on (banjo)... There was nine of us because Chick Webb's band was on band.

ctx.x: Oh, the guy that went with Claude Hopeton.
With Claude Hopeton (unintelligible) Billy Taylor was on bass. Sammy Hodges on drums -- no relation to Johnny Hodges -- Paul Bernett was on (banjo) (unintelligible).
